label: H.R. 9368
title: Voter ID Act

items.snippet: …individual (1) submits the ballot with a copy of their photo identification or the last four digits of their Social Security number with an affidavit attesting that the individual is unable to obtain a copy of a valid photo…
This prohibition shall not apply to overseas military voters and certain disabled or elderly voters.
The Election Assistance Commission must make grants to states and tribal governments that provide eligible individuals with free valid photo identification.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

S001213.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
S001213.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
S001213.note: None of this member's itemized donors work in the industries of this bill's lobbying clients.
